address: The Walled Garden, Riverground Stables, Midhurst, West Sussex,GU29 9AL
bio: Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea at The Walled Garden, an idyllic hideaway nestled at the heart of the Cowdray Estate and located in the grounds of one of England's finest former Tudor houses.  Their Afternoon Tea menu has been expertly crafted using the best of local and Estate produce, inspired by The Walled Garden itself. Tuck into a selection of finely cut sandwiches, scones with Cornish clotted cream and strawberry jam and a tempting array of sweet treats, including delicate Viennese biscuits infused with lavender grown from the garden.  Almost everything is better when shared, which is why their Afternoon Tea has been made by their talented catering team for two to enjoy. As a result, you are only able to book for even numbers. For groups with odd numbers, we recommend booking a larger afternoon tea so there is plenty to share and take home.  Afternoon Tea is available to pre-book on the following dates in 2023:  Monday 8 th May Sunday 21 st May Sunday 11 th June Wednesday 14 th June Sunday 18 th June Sunday 9 th July Sunday 13 th August
